notes: `templateFlavorForFilename` (lines 244-251) is a plain filename-prefix sniff: "purpur-" -> `.purpur`, "pufferfish" -> `.pufferfish`, "minecraft_server-" -> `.vanilla`, "fabric-server-launch" -> `.fabric`, and everything else (including plain "paper-...") falls to the `.paper` default (line 250) -- there is no case for NeoForge/Forge filenames because `archiveServerJar` never produces one to archive in the first place, so a `templateId` can never actually resolve to those flavors. `templateFilenameFromId` (lines 239-243) strips the fixed `"paper:"` kind-prefix `templateIdFor` (lines 236-238) adds when building the id in the first place -- the `"paper:"` kind label here names the *template bucket* (Paper-template-directory), not the resolved `JavaServerFlavor`, which is a naming collision worth carrying a note into the Rust port about rather than silently renaming away.
